edit.description: Derive the tag-charset seam-gate tests from renderSchemaForPrompt()'s actual output per engineering.md, not a hand-copied literal.

summary: Fix tag-charset seam-gate tests to read the real rendered hint instead of a hand-copied literal sample.

per.section: A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote

tests: tag charset accepted by parsePending is extracted from renderSchemaForPrompt()'s actual output, not a hardcoded sample string
tag charset rejected by parsePending (whitespace) is extracted from renderSchemaForPrompt()'s actual output, not a hardcoded literal
acceptance: Both 'tag: every character...' and 'tag: whitespace...' tests (tests/PendingSchema.test.ts:1042-1058) derive their input from parsing renderSchemaForPrompt()'s hint text, the way extractCharBound already does for the numeric bound, so a coreTagHint charset edit without a matching TAG_PATTERN change fails these tests.
notes: Found sweeping tests/PendingSchema.test.ts neighborhood. coreTagHint literal at src/PendingSchema.ts:480, TAG_PATTERN at src/PendingSchema.ts:96 — currently two hand-synced copies with no test tying them together.
